title: 完成证据与未完成项分开说
premise: 两周迭代结束：首个日报切片已按约定样本验收，扩展异常数据测试未全部完成，尚未生产发布。
listeningTask: 听清实际完成、遗留任务及不能宣称的结果。

lines.en: Just to recap, the first slice passed. Additional malformed-data tests will carry over separately.
lines.zh: 小结：首个切片通过，额外异常数据测试单独转下轮。

lines.en: The agreed acceptance criteria are met. The extra cases extend coverage beyond those fixtures.
lines.zh: 约定验收标准已满足，额外用例扩展此前fixture之外的覆盖。

lines.en: Full extraction was a stretch, as expected. Just to confirm, no production release yet, right?
lines.zh: 完整提取如预期只是挑战目标，确认一下，尚未生产发布，对吧？

lines.en: Right, consumer sign-off covers isolated report comparisons. Operational release still needs its own approval.
lines.zh: 对，使用方验收仅针对隔离报表对比，运行上线另需批准。

lines.en: What made review easier this iteration? We should preserve the practices that actually helped.
lines.zh: 本轮什么让评审更容易？保留真正有效的实践。

lines.en: Small changes and fixed fixtures helped most. Maybe discovery deserves an earlier owner next time.
lines.zh: 小改动和固定fixture最有帮助，下次梳理可能应更早指定负责人。

lines.en: Agreed, waiting for samples delayed meaningful feedback. We shouldn't blame implementation for every delay.
lines.zh: 同意，等样本延迟了有效反馈，不能把所有延期归到实现。

lines.en: One action item is tracking sample dependencies. We'll compare waiting time in the next iteration.
lines.zh: 一项任务是跟踪样本依赖，下轮比较等待时长。

lines.en: Faster local tests are a useful result. They don't prove production reliability has improved yet.
lines.zh: 本地测试更快是有用结果，但还不能证明生产可靠性提高。

lines.en: Good distinction, I'll keep that in the summary. Today's evidence supports maintainability, not outage reduction.
lines.zh: 区分得对，总结保留，今天证据支持可维护性，不证明故障减少。

scene: 两周迭代结束：首个日报切片已按约定样本验收，扩展异常数据测试未全部完成，尚未生产发布。
